finding: Whole-image assembly-score advantage survives observed repeated-scene and presentation controls.
mechanism_interpretation: Local appearance and assembly relation require different retained information. Observational controls weaken simple source/presentation confounds without demonstrating causal use of chassis.
application: Retain region coverage for exploratory inspection and frozen whole-image priority for evaluated assembly cohort. Do not install region presence as assembly classifier.
source_limit: Four within-test triplicate scenes recognized. No confirmed dev/test same-scene pair; one unresolved blurred pair retained in main analysis and excluded only in sensitivity.
